title: 2 year yield / treasury / interest rates | Data Release Other | 2-Year Treasury Yield (DGS2) — FRED Snapshot
summary: The 2-Year Treasury Yield stood at 3.78% as of 2026-04-21, up 6 basis points from the prior day's 3.72%. The yield has held in a narrow band between 3.71% and 3.78% over the preceding week, with no outsized moves. This instrument is the most rate-sensitive point on the U.S. Treasury curve, reflecting near-term rate expectations.
